susinstantswap.description: Hold Alt: short press toggles inventory, long press for instant swap. Works in all game modes.
config.susinstantswap.title: Su's Instant Swap Config
config.susinstantswap.modEnabled.tooltip: When OFF, the mod is completely disabled.
config.susinstantswap.longPressMode.tool: When OFF: only long-press swap remains
config.susinstantswap.holdThresholdMs.to: Press duration above this is treated as long press. Range: 50-1000ms, default 200ms.
config.susinstantswap.soundEnabled.toolt: Play a sound effect when swapping items.
config.susinstantswap.mouseReposition.to: Move mouse to the bottom-right corner of the inventory UI when opened.
config.susinstantswap.guiSwapEnabled.too: When enabled, press the swap key while hovering over an item in any GUI to swap and close the screen.
config.susinstantswap.emptySlotSwapEnabl: When enabled, pressing the swap key on an empty slot will also perform the swap (e.g. move hotbar item to backpack).
config.susinstantswap.debug.tooltip: Output debug messages to the game log.
susinstantswap.configuration.title: Su's Instant Swap Configuration
